The test image shows **banana fruits** (not leaves) with:
- Large dark brown/black irregular spots distributed across the ripe yellow fruit surface
- Progressive blackening on the more severely affected bottom fruit
- No tip-only restriction (ruling out Cigar End Rot)

The Anthracnose reference image showed near-identical symptoms: dark irregular lesions on banana fruit surfaces with progressive darkening. This pattern of post-harvest fruit rot with scattered dark sunken lesions is the hallmark of **Anthracnose** (caused by *Colletotrichum musae*).
